page_title: NOT 1-0 MNU | Nottingham Forest v Manchester Utd 01/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's it for today, Jarred Gillett has blown his whistle and the game is over.

90+7' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low into the middle of the goal, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
90+4' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Harry Maguire (Manchester United), but the defence gets it clear.
90+2' Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is first to react to a great cross from Patrick Dorgu, but slices his shot well wide of the left post from inside the box.
90+2' The ball is cleared after Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
90+1' Neco Williams (Nottingham) wasted a golden chance to score after he found some space inside the box and unluckily volleyed the ball narrowly over the bar.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Flag goes up against Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
89' The corner from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is hurriedly cleared.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Harry Maguire (Manchester United) is coming onto the pitch as Leny Yoro cannot continue after picking up an injury.
86' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Taiwo Awoniyi leaves the pitch and Ibrahim Sangare (Nottingham) comes on.
85' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Anthony Elanga will be replaced by Ramon Sosa (Nottingham).
84' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.
83' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
80' Mason Mount (Manchester United) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
78' Ruben Amorim has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mason Mount (Manchester United) replacing Joshua Zirkzee.
78' Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jarred Gillett had an easy-decision to make.
78' The resulting corner from Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) only finds one of the defenders, who heads it out of danger.
77' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
76' A header by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) from very close range goes towards the middle of the target, but doesn't get past Matz Sels, who makes a nice save.
73' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) finds space on the edge of the box, but his wild shot goes high over the bar.
71' Neco Williams (Nottingham) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
71' The attendance for today's match is 30249.
70' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) misses the left post by a whisker with a mid-range rebound. What a chance that was!
69' The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
69' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) picks up the ball and goes on a great solo run. He decides to shoot from mid-range but his attempt is comfortably blocked by a defender.
68' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
67' Substitution. Elliot Anderson did his best and is replaced by Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham).
66' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is cautioned by the referee.
65' The corner kick from Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.

65' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. Manchester Utd have a corner.
62' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle and signals a foul after Ryan Yates (Nottingham) brought his opponent down.
61' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
60' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Nottingham.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) will replace Casemiro.
59' Unlucky! A great strike from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) near the edge of the box had the keeper scrambling but flew just over the bar.
57' Jarred Gillett blows his whistle. Casemiro (Manchester United) commits a foul after dangerous play.
56' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 31:69.
53' Neco Williams (Nottingham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
51' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
51' Murillo (Nottingham) sends over a free kick from long range but the defence is alert.
50' Casemiro (Manchester United) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
49' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is flagged for offside.
49' Neco Williams (Nottingham) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
48' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Nottingham get a corner.
48' Casemiro (Manchester United) jumps inside the box to meet the corner and aims a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper pulls off an astonishing save to deny him.
47' Manchester Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.
47' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Ruben Amorim probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Manuel Ugarte (Manchester United). He is replaced by Rasmus Hojlund.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+6' Casemiro (Manchester United) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post.
45+5' The shots on goal statistics – 2:3.

45+4' Alejandro Garnacho almost found himself in a promising position after Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
45+1' Morato (Nottingham) finds some space in the penalty area and produces a bullet of a header towards the top left corner, but his attempt is denied by the goalkeeper.
45+1' Jarred Gillett has a clear sight and sees a foul from Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United).
45' 6 additional min. will be played.
43' Manchester Utd seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
40' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Danilo is replaced by Morato (Nottingham).
39' Ola Aina (Nottingham) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Alex Moreno.
36' It doesn’t look good for Ola Aina (Nottingham); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
35' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.

34' Neco Williams (Nottingham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The linesman points to the corner flag, Nottingham are going to take it.
33' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Jarred Gillett blows his whistle for a foul.
31' That's unlucky! Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
29' A player from Manchester Utd commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
28' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) sees his header crash off the crossbar after meeting a corner kick inside the six-yard box. The goalkeeper would have been helpless.
28' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) will take the corner.
27' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is able to continue to play.
26' Ryan Yates (Nottingham) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Jarred Gillett signals.
24' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
23' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
23' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
22' The Manchester Utd players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
20' 31:69 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
18' A pass from Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is intercepted by Matz Sels and the move breaks down.
16' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) swings in a cross from the corner, but Matz Sels reads it well and gathers the ball.

15' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.

15' Joshua Zirkzee (Manchester United) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
13' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) times his run into the box beautifully and plants a good looking header at goal from the corner, but the ball flashes just wide of the right post.
12' Good work from Manchester Utd as they win a corner.
12' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
10' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
9' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) plays a one-two with Taiwo Awoniyi, but the move breaks down.

5' 1 - 0 GOAL! Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) receives the ball after a swift counter attack. Still with some work to do, he weaves his way through the defence to score a wonderful goal from close range to make it 1:0.
5' The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
4' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) receives a pass then lets rip from long range towards the bottom left corner, but Matz Sels watches it all the way and makes an easy save.
2' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
